The national leadership of the City Boy Movement has relieved Mas’ud Rahamaniyya of his appointment as the Director of the movement in Sokoto State. The decision, which takes effect from Tuesday, was communicated in an official letter signed by the movement’s Director-General, Francis Shoga, on Wednesday. The letter, with reference number CBM/DG/SD.SOK/2026/700, was addressed to Rahamaniyya in Sokoto State. “I write on behalf of the national leadership of the City Boy Movement to inform you that you are relieved of your appointment as State Director of the Sokoto State Chapter with effect from 17 November 2026,” the letter stated. The national leadership, however, clarified that the decision was purely administrative and should not be interpreted as a disciplinary action or an indication of any wrongdoing by the former state director. The letter further wished him success in his future endeavours. The development comes as political activities gather momentum ahead of the 2027 general elections, with various support groups intensifying efforts to mobilise grassroots support for President Bola Tinubu’s re-election bid. However, the movement had yet to announce a replacement for Rahamaniyya as of the time of filing this report. Animashaun Salman
